anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.

bible_refs.note: Quoted twice: world crucified to me and I to the world; boast only in the cross.
Quoted: having stripped the principalities and authorities, he made a show, triumphing on the wood.

choices.why: Hedge before the hard saying that he is not crucified for all.

pass_a_gloss: perhaps [gap] Christ is sacrificed, but he has not been crucified for all but for those able to say: But to me the world has been crucified and I to the world, and for those able to say: Having stripped the principalities and the authorities he made an example, triumphing in the wood, and for those able to say: But may it not be for me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom the world has been crucified to me and I to the world.
pass_b_english: perhaps [lacuna] Christ is sacrificed, but he has not been crucified [for all], but [for] those who [are able] to say: "But to me the world has been crucified, and I to the world," and for those who are able to say: "Having stripped the principalities and the authorities, he made a show of them, triumphing on the wood," and for those who are able to say: "But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world."
source_text: τάχα ... ὁ Χ(ριστὸ)ς θύ[ετ]αι, οὐ π[ᾶσι] δ[’ ἐ]σ[τ(αύ)ρ(ωτ)αι ἀλλὰ [το]ῖς δυ[ναμέ]νοις ε[ἰ]πεῖν· "Ἐμοὶ δὲ [κόσμο]ς ἐστ(αύ)ρ(ωτ)αι κἀγὼ κόσμῳ"[,] καὶ τοῖς δυναμένοις εἰπεῖν· "Ἀπεκδυσάμενος τὰς ἀρχὰς καὶ τὰς ἐξουσίας ἐδειγματίσεν θριαμβεύσας ἐν τῷ ξύλῳ", καὶ τοῖς δυναμένοις εἰπεῖν· "Ἐμοὶ δὲ|| μὴ γένοιτο καυχᾶσθαι εἰ μὴ ἐν τῷ στ(αυρ)ῷ τοῦ κ(υρίο)υ ἡμῶν Ἰ(ησο)ῦ Χ(ριστο)ῦ, δι’ οὗ ἐμοὶ κόσμος ἐστ(αύ)ρ(ωτ)αι κἀγὼ κόσμῳ."
